# Comparator exposure-response and short-obligation scope — v1

2026-11-14. Prospective scope completion of024c1f50 and existing four-control graph, before values. Same producer author/reviewer lineage.

The gross1.25 / absolute-net.25 / name.75 modeled exposure RESPONSE thresholds apply to DYNAMIC_SPREAD and STATIC_SPREAD only, at their selected preconstruction/completed-or-terminated-pair checkpoints. They are not copied onto DYNAMIC_HALF_LONG, whose intended positive net~.5 would otherwise be suppressed into a different baseline. Required survival remains candidateDYNAMIC_SPREAD only; static failures reported separately.

DYNAMIC_HALF_LONG preserves the selected stronger-name+.5 ownD_NAV/restRF0cash monthly rule, with actual whole units, raw quotes/actions/costs, serial admissions and no future-price target increase. It has NO added gross/net/name response thresholds in this first comparison; nominal half target is not a guaranteed continuous exposure limit. All applicable own cash, initial equity, currentmaintenance/equitybuffer, due-payment/unsupported-input, sticky default, actual fill and causal forced-reduction rules STILL apply. Report its actual exposure drift/extrema and risk so differing constraints remain visible. This is an economically different lowergross control, not a riskmatched/neutral alpha benchmark. Do not silently impose a new comparator cap or full-leverage substitute. CASH staysRF0cash, no security targets.

Locate success/failure and paired-entry cancellation apply only to an actual proposed new short in a SPREAD account. HALF_LONG needs no short locate and is not cancelled by a borrow/locate-denial scenario merely because spread could not borrow. It may still be affected by the sameissuer price/execution blackout and actual shared source event as prebound. No short borrow fee/payable is charged without an actual short liability; no invented borrowing cost on HALF_LONG or CASH. Fees/actions/accrual apply to each account's real modeled holdings and orders. Staticspread has its own locate tokens/actualshorts/loan obligations, never reuse candidatecap across accounts.

Same underlyingissuer shock selection and source/vintage/timing limitations stay. Different exposure-response constraints are explicit model/account definitions, not reason to change effect thresholds or choose a favorable comparator after results. Exact criteria and reporting unchanged otherwise. No retained/native study execution, new parameter search/candidate reservation or48account allocation.
